rule: Resolve primary artist versus guest/remix/member/composite credit. Identity resolution does not itself create AllMusic source support.

records.note: The Path To Decay on The 13th Floor is Sirenia; Mortemia is not the primary artist identity for this track.
Don Dixon is a mix credit; primary recording identity remains The dB's.
Sascha Paeth is a production/person credit; primary artist identity remains Asrai.
Blue Stahli is the remixer credit; primary artist identity remains Collide.
Joint primary collaboration on Don't Explain; preserve both primary artists.
AllMusic contains multiple distinct Green Machine identities; Horse does not safely identify the Japanese band or another same-name act.
Lost Reason / Pop: Korn evidence does not safely map to a specific Pendragon identity.
Honor for All is a two-person collaboration credit; preserve both identities rather than force one artist.
